label: Descent
description: National or ethnic descent adjectives, sampled with a uniform prior.
notes: National or ethnic descent adjectives at a named people or country level, never continental categories. A descent word means that heritage's typical look: each value carries the colouring families typical of that heritage for drawing (skin_family, eye_family, hair_family, texture), and a person's skin tone, eye colour, hair colour and texture drawn after it are weighted toward them (a mismatch stays possible, rarely). These are drawing defaults, not claims about any person; nations with wide variation carry every family. Membership categories can overlap and are neither exhaustive nor a claim about citizenship. Bengali and Bangladeshi, Punjabi and Indian, Tamil and Indian or Sri Lankan, and Pashtun and Pakistani or Afghan are retained as distinct ethnic and national descent labels with overlapping membership. Values also read before woman or man. Mixed descent is left to explicit composition rather than enumerating pairs.
